description:
Foldable & Convenient Design:Features a 6061 aluminum alloy foldable frame with a step-thru design, making it easy to store, transport, and perfect for urban commuting or traveling.

Dual Riding Modes & Human-Powered Option: With pure electric and electric assist modes, riders can effortlessly cruise at their preferred pace. Additionally, the option for pure human riding allows for exercise and flexibility in riding styles.

Long-Lasting & Removable Battery:The 48V 13Ah lithium-ion battery provides ample power for extended rides. Plus, its removable feature allows for convenient charging options.

Impressive Range in Both Modes: Offers a substantial range of 40 km in pure electric mode and 60 km in pedal-assist mode, ensuring you can confidently take on your daily commutes or leisure rides.

Powerful & Intelligent Motor:The rear drive 48V 250W high-speed brushless hub motor provides efficient and reliable power, delivering a maximum speed of 25 km/h. Additionally, the intelligent sine wave controller enhances motor performance and efficiency.

Comfort and Safety Features: Enjoy a comfortable ride with soft rubber grips, a body geometry comfortable sponge saddle, and a suspension fork with lock for smooth rides on various terrains. The integrated LED headlight, e-horn, and taillight ensure visibility and safety, even during nighttime rides.

Versatile 7-Speed Gears & Shimano Shifter Levers:The 7-speed gears and Shimano shifter levers offer smooth and precise gear changes, enabling riders to conquer inclines and varied terrain effortlessly.

Practical Accessories: Equipped with a phone holder featuring a USB charging port, a rear rack, basket, rearview mirrors, tools, and full coverage fenders, our e-bike caters to your convenience and practical needs.

Easy to Assemble: This e-bike comes 85% pre-assembled. A video guide is available in the product page. Comes with a rear rack and mudguards

Professional Customer Service: 1-year warranty for battery, charger, motor and controller. If you run into any trouble with our bikes, pls contact us, we’ll reply your message within 24 hours. Pls keep the original bike box for 30 days for possible returns
